title: Extrapolation of Periodic Functions Using Binary Encoding of Continuous Numerical Values
abstract: arXiv:2512.10817v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce Normalized Base-2 Encoding (NB2E) as a method for encoding continuous numerical values and demonstrate that, using this input encoding, vanilla multi-layer perceptrons (MLP) successfully extrapolate four periodic waveforms without prior knowledge of their functional form. We contrast this finding with fixed Fourier encoding, which extrapolates well when the number of signal cycles over the normalized domain is an even integer and loses coherence at most other values, whereas NB2E degrades gradually away from those values and, except near odd cycle counts, remains substantially more accurate. These findings are limited to a single MLP architecture trained on one synthetic, exactly periodic, one-dimensional signal at a time, with extrapolation extending only to the end of the normalized domain. We do not propose a mechanism for this phenomenon. Rather, we present empirical observations which merit further study.

translated_title: 利用连续数值的二进制编码实现周期函数的外推
translated_abstract: 我们提出归一化二进制编码（Normalized Base-2 Encoding, NB2E）作为一种对连续数值进行编码的方法，并证明在这种输入编码下，普通多层感知机（MLP）在事先不知道周期波形函数形式的情况下，能够成功地对四种周期波形进行外推。我们将这一结果与固定傅里叶编码进行对比：固定傅里叶编码仅在信号周期数在归一化域内为偶数整数时外推良好，而在大多数其他取值下会失去一致性；相比之下，NB2E 在偏离这些取值时性能逐渐下降，并且除奇数周期数附近外，始终保持显著更高的精度。这些发现仅限于在每次训练一个合成、严格周期的一维信号的单个 MLP 架构上，外推范围也仅延伸到归一化域的末端。我们并未为这一现象提出机理解释，而是给出了一些值得进一步研究的经验性观察。
tldr: 提出归一化二进制编码（NB2E）作为连续数值的输入编码方式，使普通多层感知机无需预知函数形式即可成功外推周期波形，且精度显著优于固定傅里叶编码。
en_tdlr: Normalized Base-2 Encoding (NB2E) enables vanilla MLPs to extrapolate periodic waveforms without prior knowledge of their functional form, substantially outperforming fixed Fourier encoding.
